prompt:

- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Care Basics Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen demonstrating desktop controls, right-click menus, and pet interaction features before completing setup. (why: Support receives frequent emails under [after_onboarding, confusion] asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign In Path Reorder: Move the sign_in screen after pet creation screens (pick_friend and upload_photos), allowing users to pick or design their pet before authenticating. (why: sign_in early in the flow drops 27.1% of users. Allowing users to build affinity with their pet first increases sign-in motivation.)
2: [home, new_flow] Companion Stage Live Audio Waiting Room: Add an ambient sound player and stage loading animation on the waiting screen while pet generation processes in the background. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and support received bug reports of users thinking the app stalled during pet generation.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Special Adoption Certificate Crest Incentive: Display a verified ownership crest badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops off 28.2%. Visual incentives like verified crests increase pride of completion.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account Retrieval & Lost Pet Recovery Option: Add explicit account recovery guidance text on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to use their original sign-in method. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary account.)
5: [adoption, layout] Full Bleed Companion Discovery Showcase: Switch the pet selection screen layout to full bleed, highlighting full artwork previews of available pets. (why: Pet adoption choice takes median 89s. Full bleed visual presentation makes selection faster and more engaging.)
6: [home, copy] Desktop Display Verification Readiness Headline: Update waiting screen text to explicitly inform users that the pet will appear directly on their desktop screen once loading completes. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not appearing on desktop or users missing the initial spawn window.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Sound & Behavior Setup Screen: Add a pre-arrival behavior preferences screen where users configure initial pet sound effects and activity levels. (why: Finish step conversion drops 28.2% and mean time is 5815s. Giving users control over pet volume and behavior reduces post-onboarding confusion.)
